description_en: Retrieves the details of a device distribution task
description_zh: 调用该接口获取设备分发任务的详细信息
name: QueryDeviceDistributeJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the distribution task. This is the globally unique identifier of the task
parameters.help_zh: 分发任务ID。任务的全局唯一标识符
parameters.name: job_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The details of the device distribution task returned if the call was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功后，返回的设备分发任务详情

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the distribution task was created

JobId.description_en: The ID of the distribution task

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs

Status.description_en:
The status of the distribution task.

0: The task is initialized.

1: The task is running.
 
2: The task is completed. This status only indicates that the distribution task has finished execution, not that all products and devices were distributed successfully. To obtain the distribution result details, call [QueryDeviceDistributeDetail]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199533.html）.

3: The task is interrupted due to an exception
Status.description_zh:
分发任务状态。

0：任务初始化。

1：任务执行中。
 
2：任务完成。该状态仅表示分发任务执行完成，不表示所有产品和设备都分发成功。获取分发结果详情，请调用[QueryDeviceDistributeDetail]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199533.html）。

3：任务异常中断

Strategy.description_en:
The distribution strategy.

0: Specified region. The devices are distributed to a specified instance in a specified region.
1: Nearest access. Multiple instance IDs across regions are configured, and devices dynamically connect to the nearest region based on their IP locations
Strategy.description_zh:
分发策略。

0：指定地域，将设备分发到指定地域的指定实例。
1：就近接入，配置了多个地域的实例ID，设备将根据设备的IP位置动态接入其中距离最近的地域

Total.description_en: The total number of devices in the distribution task
Total.description_zh: 分发任务中的设备总数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
